name: France
hook: Kings, revolutionaries and one very recognizable language: the France clues keep circling the same cast.

facts.label: the French Republic
facts.statement: France is a country in Western Europe whose official language is French, one of the six official languages of the United Nations.

facts.label: Napoleon Bonaparte
facts.statement: Napoleon Bonaparte escaped exile on Elba in February 1815 and returned to France; his final defeat came at Waterloo that June.

facts.label: Louis XIV
facts.statement: Louis XIV, the Sun King, was great-grandfather of Louis XV and revoked the Edict of Nantes, driving Huguenots out of France.

facts.label: Louis XVI
facts.statement: Louis XVI, the last absolute Bourbon king, was guillotined in 1793; his Austrian wife Marie Antoinette married him in 1770 and was executed too.

facts.label: Charles de Gaulle
facts.statement: Charles de Gaulle led the Free French after 1940 and later, as president, pulled France out of NATO's military command in 1966.

facts.label: Joan of Arc
facts.statement: Joan of Arc, the peasant girl who led French forces against the English, was canonized by Pope Benedict XV in 1920.

facts.label: Corsica
facts.statement: Corsica, Napoleon's birthplace, was bought from Genoa in 1768 and is called "The Scented Isle" for its fragrant flowers.
